reviewer: Claude (independent read-only review; did not author the exporter)
verdict: APPROVED. The closed exporter is exactly the declared delta from my earlier reviewed terminal-records.c: four fixed names and caps, the DL19_RECORD_ prefix, closed phase only, and checked close() of the read fd and the directory. No live mode, spawn verdict or whitelist claim is added. The original terminal-records exporter (28a78670 / c8f2193d) is unchanged. Host-file evidence only: no Darwin spawn, descriptor or runtime result.

binding.source_set: Recomputed: all 5 files_sha256 entries match, no extra files, and the set equals 37d3d535. A __pycache__ directory left by root's test run sits outside the manifest.
binding.base: terminal-records.c 28a78670 and decode_records.py c8f2193d recompute equal to the derived_from hashes.
binding.sdk_build_cross_check: Binary /nix/store/rb6yj9va.../usr/bin/darwin-spawn-records: sha256 recomputed as 62aa243284b4da868de0c18233b2d5bd1ce68a7b747a5464adfbeef5e1fd7ad9. Its derivation xnmcqc0l embeds spawn-records.c jsvwafc9 (fd0ebeda, the frozen file). dependencies.txt lists only /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib. llvm-nm -u gives the same 18 imports as reports/sprint-010/managed-spawn-records-sdk-build-001.json, and exactly the same 18 as the reviewed base exporter d4mp8j3p darwin-terminal-records.

source_delta.records: result.json 16384, stdout.bin 256, stderr.bin 256, status.bin 256, all required (spawn-records.c:20-23). The decoder LIMITS match (decode_records.py:5).
source_delta.prefix: Every emitted line is DL19_RECORD_{MISSING,REFUSED,BEGIN,HEX,END}. The decoder accepts only DL19_RECORD_ lines, distinct from the DL11 terminal exporter and from the supervisor's DL19_SPAWN_ markers.
source_delta.closed_only: main returns 2 unless argv[6]=='closed' (spawn-records.c:97-99); the decoder rejects any other phase. A closed export requires every record (a MISSING line returns -1, and the decoder rejects it), and after.st_size must equal before.st_size.
source_delta.close_checks: close(fd) failure fails the record (line 63). close(directory) failure fails the run (line 108).
source_delta.unchanged_logic: Directory: O_DIRECTORY and O_NOFOLLOW, owner euid, no group/other bits. Files: openat with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK; regular, nlink 1, owner euid, no group/other bits, size at most the cap. Exact-length read with EINTR retry. Same dev/inode after the read. SHA-256 over the captured bytes. 64-byte hex chunks. ferror and fflush are checked.

independent_host_checks_scratch.root_tests: The 5 frozen tests were rerun on a scratch copy (no bytecode written into the source tree): 5/5 OK.
adversarial: Empty records: BEGIN bytes=0, END chunks=0, decode OK.
Missing directory: rc 1 with no output; decode gives 'Incomplete export'.
Exact caps (16384 and 256) OK. result.json at 16385 bytes gives a REFUSED line and rc 1; the decoder rejects it.
Non-prefixed console noise between records is skipped and the decode still succeeds.
An END line with a corrupted prefix is skipped; the next BEGIN then fails as nested.
An extra unexpected file in the directory is ignored (the exporter reads only its four names).
A forged earlier export followed by the real one fails as repeated.

notes.R1_silent_record_failure: Inherited from the base: short read, changed inode or size, close failure or a digest failure end the record without a per-record marker. The signal is rc 1, plus the decoder's 'Incomplete export' or nested-record error. Fails closed.
notes.R2_extra_files_not_reported: The exporter neither lists nor detects other files in the records directory.
notes.R3_mode_check_is_mask_based: The directory and files must have no group/other bits; an exact 0700/0600 mode is not required.
notes.R4_vestigial_fields: live_required and the closed variable remain but are constant in closed-only use. Harmless.
notes.R5_recipe_include_root: build.nix uses -isystem $DARWIN_SDK_ROOT/usr/include, whereas the base and other lab C recipes use the PureDarwin libSystem headers. The PROVENANCE delta text does not mention this. It has no observed effect: the import set is identical to the base binary's. It is recorded for provenance completeness.

scope: Read-only: frozen sources, the base exporter, SDK record, store binary hash, derivation text and import tables. Host tests ran only on scratch copies. No edits, target execution, SSH or hardware.
